title: Input source list
statement:
For a natural number $W$, Booleans $t_0,p_0,p_1,p_{N1}$, and a layout position $i\in\{0,1,2\}$, form a list beginning with constant sources carrying, in order, $t_0,p_1,p_0,p_{N1}$, and $
eg p_0\land
eg p_{N1}$, followed by the layout source at $i$. Add the three neighbor-source terms specified by $
eg t_0\land
eg p_0$, $
eg t_0$, and $
eg t_0\land
eg p_{N1}$ at their indicated indices, then the conditional current sources at positions $1$ and $2$, each selected using $
eg p_0$, and finally the conditional postponed-source list of length $W$ determined by $t_0$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural-number parameter $k$ for the source type
caveat: The snippet uses the auxiliary operation `nbS` but does not provide its definition or informal description, so the neighbor-source terms cannot be explained fully.
